summary: Friday's close capped a volatile week: the VIX held near four standard deviations above its average, keeping equities in Fear as losses concentrated in growth and tech names while consumer staples and long-duration Treasuries drew defensive flows. Credit spreads widened against governments, reinforcing the bond bid, even as gold and crypto showed early signs of stabilizing.
tweet: Elevated volatility and a tech-to-staples, equity-to-bond rotation defined Friday's close, while gold and crypto showed early signs of stabilizing.
